newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Albright still planning China visit -- spokesman.
newsitem.headline: Albright still planning China visit -- spokesman.

text.p: U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright expects to go ahead with a planned trip to Beijing despite the death of paramount Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping, her spokesman said Thursday.
"I expect the secretary's trip to Beijing is going to go forward," spokesman Nicholas Burns told reporters after her arrival in Moscow.
In Washington, White House press secretary Mike McCurry said: "I am not aware of any changes."
The State Department has had some preliminary contacts with the Chinese government but details gave not been fixed, Burns said. It was not yet known if there would be any changes in the schedule.
Albright, on an 11-day, nine-nation trip through Europe and Asia, had been due to visit Beijing next Monday and Tuesday.
The funeral for Deng, who died on Wednesday at the age of 92, has been set for Tuesday.
